_comment: Three Forever trees (Wowhead per task statement). status modelled -> effect read by the engine; unmodelled -> reason. Row r needs 5*r points in the same tree before the pick.

talents.name: Improved Life Tap
talents.source: Confirmed: +10% mana per rank (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Suppression
talents.source: Confirmed numbers: +1% hit and -4% threat per rank, 5%/20% at 5/5 (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026)). Assumed to apply to ALL spells (text says 'your chance to hit'); no source states a school restriction.

talents.name: Improved Corruption
talents.source: Confirmed: -0.4 s cast and +2% damage per rank (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026)); Corruption cast is 2 s (wiki)

talents.name: Grim Reach
talents.source: Range talent

talents.name: Soul Harvest
talents.source: Confirmed: 50%/100% regen for 10 s after a kill under Drain Soul, same share continues while casting (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Improved Drains
talents.source: Confirmed: +20% at 3/3 (7% shown at rank 1 = linear) (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026)); applies to Drain Life, Drain Soul, Drain Mana (not Wrack)

talents.name: Improved Bane of Agony
talents.source: Confirmed: +5% per rank (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Fel Concentration
talents.source: Confirmed: 23% per rank, 70% at 3/3, chance not to lose cast time when damaged while channelling Drain Life/Mana/Soul and Wrack (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Amplify Curse
talents.reason: 3 minute cooldown, empowers one curse/bane per 3 minutes; ignored in short pulls
talents.source: Task

talents.name: Pandemic
talents.source: Confirmed: +33% per rank, +100% at 3/3 of the crit damage BONUS of Corruption, Agony, Doom, Drain Soul, Drain Life, Siphon Life, Wrack (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026)) -> crit multiplier 1 + 0.5 x (1 + r/3)

talents.name: Malevolence
talents.source: Confirmed: +1% crit chance per rank on ALL Shadow spells, 5% at 5/5 (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Nightfall
talents.source: Confirmed: 2% per rank per hit of Corruption, Drain Soul, Drain Life and Wrack; Shadow Trance makes the next Shadow Bolt instant (mana is still paid) (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Curse of Exhaustion
talents.reason: movement slow; no effect on the model
talents.source: Task

talents.name: Siphon Life
talents.source: Spell data: spells.json (Wowhead Forever pages, warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Wrack)

talents.name: Soul Siphon
talents.source: Confirmed (hotfix 10 Nov): +4% per rank per effect of Corruption, Siphon Life, Bane of Agony on the target, max 3 effects (36% at 3/3), applies to Drain Life, Drain Soul, Wrack (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026); Blizzard hotfix notes https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/news/24315281)

talents.name: Shadow Mastery
talents.source: Confirmed: +2% Shadow damage per rank (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Wrack
talents.source: Spell data: spells.json (Wowhead Forever pages, warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Wrack)

talents.name: Improved Health Funnel
talents.source: Wowhead Forever spell 18703 (https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=18703, read 27 Nov 2026): at 2/2 Health Funnel transfers 40% more health for 30% less; per-rank scaling assumed linear. Used by the Health Funnel between pulls.

talents.name: Improved Imp
talents.source: Confirmed: +10% Firebolt damage per rank (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Demonic Embrace
talents.source: Confirmed: +3% Stamina per rank (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip)). The HP effect is an assumption: Stamina taken as half of max HP.

talents.name: Unholy Power
talents.source: Confirmed: +2% pet damage per rank (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Demonic Aegis
talents.source: Confirmed: +15% Demon Skin/Armor per rank (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip))

talents.name: Improved Voidwalker
talents.source: Confirmed: +10% per rank to Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice, Suffering (not health) (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026)). Modelled only as Torment threat; Torment's own threat value is unknown.

talents.name: Fel Vitality
talents.source: Confirmed: +5% pet HP/mana and +5% your mana per rank (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Demonic Energies
talents.source: Confirmed: heal pet for 8%/15% of your spell damage; Life Tap gives the demon 50%/100% of the mana (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Improved Sayaad
talents.source: Confirmed: +10% Lash of Pain per rank (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Demonic Sacrifice
talents.source: Confirmed: 2 h buff: Imp +15% Shadow, Succubus +15% Fire, Voidwalker 2% mana/4 s, Felhunter 3% health/4 s (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Master Summoner
talents.reason: summon speed only matters after a pet death; prerequisite for Fel Domination
talents.source: Task

talents.name: Decimation
talents.source: Wowhead Forever (user-provided max-rank text); per-rank scaling assumed linear

talents.name: Fel Domination
talents.source: Wowhead Forever (user-provided max-rank text); per-rank scaling assumed linear

talents.name: Demonic Brand
talents.source: Confirmed: threat -17%/-33%/-50%, brands 10 s, pet's next 2/4/6 attacks (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026)). Damage per attack, the same at every rank: (level-26)*1.5 + 14..17 + 0.078*SP, Fire with the Imp and Shadow otherwise, multiplied by Unholy Power and Master Demonologist (Wowhead Forever spells 1293695, 1293697, 1293698, read 26 Nov 2026; https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=1293695). An older rank 1 tooltip showed 90-93 at level 60 (guildorder.com); not used. Soul Link's 3% is applied to it as damage done by the demon (ASSUMPTION). Whether the level in the formula is the caster level is marked by the Wowhead tooltip; param brand_scale can fix it at 60.

talents.name: Improved Felhunter
talents.source: Wowhead Forever (user-provided max-rank text); per-rank scaling assumed linear

talents.name: Soul Link
talents.source: Confirmed: 30% of your damage taken goes to the demon, both deal 3% more (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Demonic Knowledge
talents.source: Confirmed: up to +33%/67%/100% of your level as spell damage for you and the demon (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Master Demonologist
talents.source: Wowhead Forever spell 23785: warlock and demon both get the effect while the demon is out (Imp +10% Fire, Succubus +10% Shadow damage, read 26 Nov 2026; https://www.wowhead.com/forever/spell=23761). Confirmed: 2% per rank (10% at 5/5) (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Demonic Pact
talents.source: Confirmed: Sacrifice survives summoning a different demon; resummoning the sacrificed one still cancels (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026))

talents.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
talents.source: Confirmed: Shadow Bolt crit -> target takes +4% per rank (20% at 5/5) Shadow damage from your attacks for 12 s (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026)). Applied to all your Shadow damage (direct and periodic); pet damage excluded (assumption).

talents.name: Bane
talents.source: Confirmed by two sources: -0.1 s cast per rank on Shadow Bolt, Immolate, Incinerate (0.5 s at 5/5) (guildorder.com/games/wow_forever/tools/talents/warlock (rank 1 tooltip); allthings.how/?p=331629 (max rank, updated 11 Nov 2026); timesaver.gg/tools/wow-forever/talent-calculator/warlock (full rank, checked 13 Nov 2026)). This matches the players' report of 1.2 s Shadow Bolt rank 1 at 5/5. The Wowhead '1 s' reading was wrong.
